subject: general
question: Lingaraja Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in Bhubaneshwar, was built during which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Somavamsi dynasty.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lingaraja Temple was built in the 11th century AD by King **Jajati Keshari **of the** Somavanshi dynasty.**

 
 
• It is built in red stone.
 
 
 
• ​The Lingaraja Temple is built in the Deula style that has four components-
 
 
• Vimana (structure containing the sanctum)
 
• Jagamohana (assembly hall)
 
• Natamandira (festival hall)
 
• Bhoga-mandapa (hall of offerings)
